latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Architecture Diagram Creator

- Provides structured guidance for creating, reviewing, and improving architecture diagrams following UML, C4, and ArchiMate standards.
- Helps users choose the appropriate diagramming standard based on their system type, target audience, and context.
- Recommends best practices for diagram elements (titles, lines, shapes, labels, color, keys) to ensure clarity and consistency.
- Addresses challenges such as inconsistent notation, representational consistency across zoom levels, and Irrational Artifact Attachment.
- Offers tool-agnostic advice suitable for various diagramming tools and presentation scenarios.
